title: Photographing Paul Barbarin's band and Emile Barnes's audition
summary: Steinau photographed Paul Barbarin's band at the Yacht Club; Allen recalls Emile Barnes's audition at the shop before Christmas and the private-party circuit.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Yeah. There were all kind of different things going on. There was a tremendous lot of music going on that we never found out about for years either. Yeah, that's true. And the little neighborhood dance halls, and how could you find out about the things? Like, you went out and took photographs of Paul Balburn's band. Right, out at the Yacht Club? At the Yacht Club.

And that, you weren't, the average person didn't get in the Yacht Club very easily. I don't know how. It was the numbers only. I don't know how I got in the Yacht Club on that particular incident. Yeah. On that particular occasion. Do you remember? No, I wasn't there. I wasn't a member. Mm-hmm. And there were three or four of us, at least, that went. Mm-hmm. And I don't quite know how it happened. It was an afternoon occasion. But the details at the moment, I don't recall.
Yeah, well, yeah, I don't even remember who was in the band exactly. But you were talking about Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Pearson, reminded me.
Right. And I think they were, I think that was the band at the time with Paul.
Yeah. Because Paul Balburn, I believe, held his audition. I was trying to.
I don't think that was an audition. I think that was a party.

Yeah, yeah. Oh, yeah. But I think that he held an audition at the record shop. It did Emil Barnes for his band for, and this was, I remember the Emil Barnes, and it was just before Christmas, because Ralph St. LaProffitt came in. And it was the very night he was leaving for New York. And on his holiday, he was a visiting lecturer, visiting artist, rather, at LSU. He was about to take off, and so it would have made, I'd say December 20th or something like that. And Myra was there to hear the band, and also was taking pictures. And, uh.

Yeah. In any case, bands then were very willing to audition and to try out. And there was a certain amount of work with private parties going on through people like Myra Menville and Dr. Edmond Suchant. Yeah. And that may have, they may have invited you out there. It would just be the only way I could think of.
